coverage: Real child owner contention, kill/reap and fresh session reacquisition.
Stale and copied clone metadata, wrong process start, versions and endpoint rejection.
Private files, replaced lock, symlink refusal and owned repository lifetime.
Temporary and metadata-only modes disable schedules and reject no-wait.
limits: Discovery returns a candidate; future authenticated API handshake must prove nonce.
macOS process start record has one-second precision and is not standalone authorization.
No serve/worker/scheduler dispatch is implemented; explicit async store close is required.
